research.summary: Timothy May stated that The Crypto Anarchist Manifesto dated to mid-1988 and was distributed at Crypto '88; he posted it electronically to the Cypherpunks list in November 1992.
research.significance: It articulated the political and social vision that influenced later cypherpunk digital-money work.
research.notes: Exact first-circulation day is not established in the source; electronic posting is dated 1992-11-22.
